title: Instant Book Availability and Host Acceptance Windows on the Keyturn Trip Booking Rate Plans
content:
Three plan figures decide how a Keyturn Trip Booking request reaches confirmation: whether the plan can confirm without the host accepting, the hours the host has to accept a request before it expires, and the completed trips a guest needs before instant book is offered to them.

| Rate plan | Instant book offered by the plan | Host acceptance window (hours) | Completed trips needed before instant book |
|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Hourly Rate Plan | yes | 1 | 0 |
| Keyturn Daily Rate Plan | yes | 8 | 3 |
| Keyturn Weekend Rate Plan | yes | 12 | 5 |
| Keyturn Weekly Rate Plan | no | 24 | 5 |
| Keyturn Monthly Rate Plan | no | 36 | 8 |
| Keyturn Extended Stay Rate Plan | no | 48 | 12 |

### Points of judgement

*Which plans carry instant book?* The Keyturn Hourly, Daily and Weekend Rate Plans carry the switch that allows a request to confirm without the host acting. The Keyturn Weekly, Monthly and Extended Stay Rate Plans do not.

*Do the three plans without instant book still publish a trips figure?* They do. The Keyturn Weekly Rate Plan publishes 5 completed trips, the Keyturn Monthly Rate Plan 8 and the Keyturn Extended Stay Rate Plan 12, alongside a switch that stands at no.

*How wide is the acceptance window?* It runs from 1 hour on the Keyturn Hourly Rate Plan to 48 hours on the Keyturn Extended Stay Rate Plan, rising at every step of the ladder.
